translated:
Even though we're this far away, all the
town rumors are nothing but bad news
about Dipan...

Hey, can't we use that <PART> ---- <PART>
...the transport magic, was it?
...Actually, I already gave it a try.

However, a strong barrier had been
cast over Dipan.

I am sorry, but it is far beyond
my power.
...At least let us pray that ships are sailing.
